items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: Yes, um, we were coming back from a job, um, about a hundred miles, uh, north of Melbourne. And, uh, oh, well, it was, uh, we'd been playing at a ball.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Uh, did he die when he was with the Frank Johnson band?

Yes, um, we were coming back from a job, um, about a hundred miles, uh, north of Melbourne. And, uh, oh, well, it was, uh, we'd been playing at a ball. It was about three in the morning. Uh, rushing to get back, uh, rushing to get back in time to have about an hour's sleep before we went back to our jobs and, uh, going a bit too fast. Frank Johnson was driving. He ran out of the road. And, uh, uh, we, uh, went over the side, uh, all of us got injured in some way or another, but, uh, Bokka was unfortunate enough…
Well, what about that band? Did it continue on the Frank Johnson band?
